integrity: Character is established by a theoretical Lefschetz formula plus exhaustive finite enumeration of all forests, conjugacy types and 120 symmetry elements; shellability is cited rather than re-proved.
scientific_limitations: Rational group-module decomposition only; no integral equivariant splitting or equivariant sphere-wedge model. The abstract ordinary sphere-wedge follows from matroid shellability. An identical result in inaccessible or unindexed literature would alter the originality assessment.
title: Two regular representations in the Petersen graphic-matroid forest complex
